children: CoreWeave priced an upsized $3.7B private offering of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033, with a $500M greenshoe and initial conversion price of about $97.85 per share. Settlement is expected Sept. 22, 2026, subject to closing conditions.

Detail
AI Analyst View
Upsized $3.7B converts at 2.875%
Large, low-coupon financing; reduces near-term cost of capital vs prior high-yield debt.
Option for +$500M more notes
Greenshoe could lift proceeds to ~$4.1B, adding liquidity but potential future dilution.
Conversion price ~$97.85 (+22.5%)
Sets dilution threshold above $79.88 spot; stock near/above level increases dilution risk.
Capped calls cost ~$498.8M
Hedges dilution up to $199.70; supportive for equity if stock rises within cap.
Settlement mix cash/stock option
Flexibility to manage dilution vs cash outlay at conversion.
Guaranteed by subs; unsecured
Ranks as senior unsecured; impacts recovery stack and credit view.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a significant balance sheet move in a capital-intensive build-out phase, adding low-coupon, equity-linked funding and hedging dilution. A larger catalyst would be clarity on deployment of proceeds into revenue-generating capacity or updated guidance showing ROI and leverage path.
